title: Fuel Weighs
logbook: Four boxes put her down to her marks with no room for the 2 t the passage burns; the 2 t box stayed ashore and the bunkers took its place.

title: The Stripe
logbook: The 4 t box paid best, but any box beside it put her in the LADEN band; leaving it ashore kept her LIGHT on 2 t of bunkers instead of 4.

title: Two Calls
logbook: The 5 t Oslo box paid best, but it rode both legs and kept her LADEN to Oslo; the 5 t Aarhus box came off halfway and she sailed the long leg LIGHT.

title: Overload
logbook: The 5 t Aberdeen box paid $11, but it put her in the DEEP band on the Teesport–Aberdeen leg; leaving it ashore saved 2 t of bunkers.

title: Full & Down
logbook: One load and no other: the 4 t Rotterdam box, the 4 t Rotterdam box and the 2 t Rotterdam box with 4 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Felixstowe, and she berthed at Rotterdam on the reserve.

title: Leave Room
logbook: Filling her with the 3 t Stavanger box at Esbjerg left no room for the Immingham pickup; sailing 2 t light into Immingham paid $7 at Stavanger.

title: Coastwise
logbook: Filling her with the 2 t Bremerhaven box at Stavanger left no room for the Kiel pickup; keeping room for it paid $12 at Bremerhaven.

title: Round the Skaw
logbook: Filling her with the 2 t Den Helder box at Rotterdam left no room for the Aarhus pickup; sailing 1 t light into Aarhus paid $9 at Den Helder.

title: The Feeder Charter
logbook: The 3 t Bremerhaven box paid $12, but it rode every leg; the 5 t Stavanger box came off at Stavanger and she sailed on lighter.

title: Dry Port
logbook: No bunkers at Dover: the fuel for the Dover–Calais leg came from Le Havre, 3 t stemmed there, and every tonne of it weighed on the first leg, so the 5 t Calais box stayed ashore.

title: Carry It
logbook: No bunkers at Dover: the fuel for the Dover–Calais leg came from Le Havre, 6 t stemmed there, and every tonne of it weighed on the first leg, so the 3 t Calais box stayed ashore.

title: Short Stem
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Dover box at Antwerp left no room for the Emden pickup; sailing 6 t light into Emden paid $12 at Southampton.

title: Channel Gale
logbook: Filling her with the 5 t Zeebrugge box at Hamburg left no room for the Zeebrugge pickup; sailing 3 t light into Zeebrugge paid $6 at Le Havre.

title: To the Tonne
logbook: One load and no other: the 1 t Cherbourg box, the 1 t Cherbourg box and the 3 t Dover box with 6 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Ostend, and she berthed at Dover on the reserve.

title: Never Bury
logbook: The small Antwerp boxes filled the second stack at Le Havre, and the Southampton box for Hamburg had nowhere to stand: nothing may sit on a box that leaves earlier. Stack the Antwerp boxes together and keep a bay clear.

title: Last On, First Off
logbook: Filling her with the 5 t Hamburg box at Calais left no room for the Antwerp pickup; keeping room for it paid $5 at Hamburg.

title: Ushant
logbook: At Le Havre par takes the 5 t Hamburg box and leaves the 2 t Zeebrugge box: it paid $8 at Hamburg and kept her in a cheaper band.

title: The Channel Charter
logbook: The 5 t Antwerp box paid $12, but it rode every leg; the 3 t Zeebrugge box came off at Zeebrugge and she sailed on lighter.

title: Over the Bar
logbook: The Antwerp bar takes her at 5 t: deliver first, burn down to it, and bunker after the bar; the 2 t Antwerp box would have kept her too deep.

title: Seine Pilot
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Antwerp box at Nantes left no room for the Goole pickup; sailing 4 t light into Goole paid $7 at Antwerp.

title: Deliver First
logbook: The 5 t Seville box rode every leg; the 3 t Bordeaux box came off at Bordeaux and she sailed on lighter.

title: Low Water
logbook: At Bremen par takes the 3 t Hamburg box and leaves the 2 t Nantes box: it paid $6 at Hamburg and kept her in a cheaper band.

logbook: One load and no other: the 2 t Duisburg box, the 2 t Duisburg box, the 3 t Cologne box and the 2 t Cologne box with 5 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Montoir, and she berthed at Cologne on the reserve.

title: Three High
logbook: The 4 t Goole box paid $12, but it put her in the LADEN band on the Strasbourg–Hamburg leg; leaving it ashore saved 1 t of bunkers.

title: Rhine Barge
logbook: Filling her with the 1 t Bordeaux box at Montoir left no room for the Bremen pickup; sailing 2 t light into Bremen paid $5 at Bordeaux.

title: Ebb Tide
logbook: At Bordeaux par takes the 5 t Goole box and leaves the 2 t Strasbourg box: it paid $12 at Goole and kept her in a cheaper band.

title: The River Charter
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Hamburg box at Rouen left no room for the Antwerp pickup; keeping room for it paid $3 at Hamburg.

title: Price Board
logbook: Bunkers were $2 at Lisbon and $3 at Santa Cruz: par stems 3 t at Lisbon, and not a tonne more than the marks allow; it saved $12 on the stem.

title: Cheap Here
logbook: The 3 t Banjul box paid $12, but it put her in the DEEP band for 2 legs; leaving it ashore saved 3 t of bunkers.

title: Las Palmas Stem
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Abidjan box at Ceuta left no room for the Lomé pickup; keeping room for it paid $6 at Abidjan.

title: Harmattan
logbook: At Abidjan par takes the 4 t Lomé box and leaves the 2 t Lomé box: it paid $9 at Lomé and kept her in a cheaper band.

title: On the Mark
logbook: One load and no other: the 4 t Santa Cruz box, the 4 t Santa Cruz box and the 3 t Tema box with 3 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Lomé, and she berthed at Tema on the reserve.

title: Barge Lots
logbook: Dakar sells bunkers in lots of 2: par stems 6 t there and plans the cargo round the barge, not the other way about.

title: Four or Seven
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Lomé box at Freetown left no room for the Dakar pickup; keeping room for it paid $6 at Lomé.

title: Gulf of Guinea
logbook: The 4 t Lisbon box paid $9, but it put her in the DEEP band for every leg; leaving it ashore saved 8 t of bunkers.

title: The Bunker Charter
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Banjul box at Lagos left no room for the Banjul pickup; sailing 5 t light into Banjul paid $12 at Abidjan.

title: Heavy Below
logbook: Heavy below light: the 5 t Livorno box had to go to the bottom of its stack, and that decided what else could stand on it.

title: Bottom Weight
logbook: The 1 t Barcelona box rode every leg; the 4 t Piraeus box came off at Piraeus and she sailed on lighter.

title: Transhipment
logbook: Filling her with the 5 t Livorno box at Algeciras left no room for the La Spezia pickup; keeping room for it paid $5 at Livorno.

title: Strait of Messina
logbook: Filling her with the 3 t Koper box at La Spezia left no room for the Algeciras pickup; keeping room for it paid $10 at Koper.

title: Full and Square
logbook: One load and no other: the 5 t Koper box and the 4 t Koper box with 6 t of bunkers put her on the mark at Marsaxlokk, and she berthed at Naples on the reserve.

title: Plugged In
logbook: The 1 t Naples reefer paid $6, but a reefer burns a tonne a leg and takes a plugged stack; par leaves it ashore.

title: Cold Chain
logbook: Filling her with the 5 t Barcelona box at Gioia Tauro left no room for the Trieste pickup; sailing 6 t light into Trieste paid $7 at Barcelona.

title: Piraeus Loop
logbook: Filling her with the 3 t Naples reefer at Koper left no room for the Livorno pickup; keeping room for it paid $10 at Algeciras.

title: The Liner Charter
logbook: The 4 t Marseille box paid $10, but it put her in the DEEP band for 2 legs; leaving it ashore saved 8 t of bunkers.

title: Sealed
logbook: The sealed boxes sail first and set her draft; the top-off that fitted round them was the 5 t Santa Cruz box, not the 2 t Santa Cruz box.

title: Madeira Fruit
logbook: Filling her with the 4 t Leixões box at Cádiz left no room for the Agadir pickup; keeping room for it paid $12 at Leixões.

title: Charter Party
logbook: Filling her with the 1 t Casablanca reefer at Tanger Med left no room for the Huelva pickup; sailing 2 t light into Huelva paid $12 at Casablanca.

title: Agadir Night
logbook: The 4 t Santa Cruz box paid $10, but it put her in the DEEP band for 2 legs; leaving it ashore saved 10 t of bunkers.
